# Vesicular Stomatitis Virus Risk Assessments

## Abstract

This GeoEpi project brings together models and analyses focused on vesicular stomatitis virus risks to the United States. Registered work includes an SEIR-SEI outbreak model, genome and geography analyses, and a California outbreak project.
